headline: Dexco Approves R$ 190 Million Non-Recurring Q3 EBITDA Impairment
summary: Dexco's board approved a non-recurring accounting write-down of approximately R$ 190 million at the EBITDA level, which will adversely impact the building material maker's third-quarter results.
why: Dexco is Brazil's leading manufacturer of ceramic tiles, sanitary ware, and wood panels, reflecting the financial health of the Brazilian construction sector.

impacts.name: Dexco SA
impacts.why: The R$ 190M write-down will directly reduce reported third-quarter EBITDA and profitability.
